definitions.explanation: Evoking sympathy or pity; unfortunate; deserving compassion.

examples.japanese: かわいそうな⟦{子犬|こいぬ}→子犬：19393_koinu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}けた→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}に→本当：00779_hontou⟧かわいそう⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I really feel sorry for him.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧かわいそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: Poor thing, to have that said to them.

notes:
かわいそう expresses pity or sympathy for someone or something in an unfortunate situation.

FORMS:
- かわいそうな + noun (pitiful ~)
- 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かわいそうだ (feel sorry for ~)
- かわいそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (expression: poor thing)

WRITING:
- Sometimes written {可哀想|かわいそう} or {可哀相|かわいそう}
- Hiragana is more common

USAGE:
- Do not confuse with ⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧ (cute)
- かわいそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as an exclamation expresses sympathy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}の{毒|どく}→気の毒：02581_kinodoku⟧: pitiful, unfortunate (slightly more formal)
- ⟦{哀|あわ}れ→哀れ：01775_aware⟧: pathetic, pitiful (literary)
- ⟦{不憫|ふびん}→不憫：22479_fubin⟧: pitiable (literary)
